parameters.command:
set +e
echo '===== [1] Procesos python vitalclinic corriendo ====='
ps aux | grep -E 'vitalclinic\.py' | grep -v grep

echo ''
echo '===== [2] Matar procesos ====='
pkill -f 'vitalclinic.py' && echo 'procesos matados' || echo 'no habia procesos'
sleep 2
ps aux | grep -E 'vitalclinic\.py' | grep -v grep || echo 'confirmado: sin procesos'

echo ''
echo '===== [3] locks en SQL Server ====='
PYTHONPATH=/opt/scripts/droguerias python3 -c "
from db_config import get_conn_str
import pyodbc
try:
    c = pyodbc.connect(get_conn_str(), timeout=10)
    cur = c.cursor()
    cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(fecha_carga) FROM Proveedores.VitalClinic_Inventario')
    r = cur.fetchone()
    print(f'VitalClinic: {r[0]} filas, ultima={r[1]}')
    c.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(f'SQL error: {e}')
"
